purpose: Teach: 語句/教え子/腑/灌/學/実技/参謀/交錯

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、調書の難解な語句を、警察、丁寧に解釈されますね
lines.en: The police really do carefully interpret the difficult terminology in the case statements, don't they.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful tone. Slight pause before the observation, as if Ren is working through something he's noticed. Respectful curiosity — not challenging, genuinely puzzled. Soft trailing inflection on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、教え子の若手警官をご指導されますね
lines.en: The police also guide young officers well, mentoring them through their work.
lines.style: Calm, steady affirmation. Warm but professional — acknowledging something good without overselling it. Even pacing. Slight nod in the voice on 「若手警官」.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯行動機に腑に落ちない点を、警察、追及されますね
lines.en: There's something about the motive in this case that doesn't quite sit right — the police are really pressing into it.
lines.style: Quieter, more concentrated. Ren zeroes in on the logical gap. Slight hesitation before naming the inconsistency, like he's checking his own reasoning. Curious but careful — not accusatory.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、寺院の灌仏会の警備もされますね
lines.en: The police also handle the security details for the Kanbutsue ceremony at the temple, don't they.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, cataloguing. Officer Takeda's voice settles into each task as a simple fact — no drama, just thoroughness. Light emphasis on 「灌仏会」 as a specific responsibility.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、古文書の學の旧字体を、警察、専門家に照会されますね
lines.en: With these old documents, the police consult specialists on the classical characters — the older written forms.
lines.style: Ren's tone becomes more technical, precise. He's moving through the investigative process step by step. Slightly faster pace here — following the logic. Respect for expertise embedded in the phrasing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、新人警官の実技試験もされますね
lines.en: And the practical exams for the new recruits — the police oversee those too.
lines.style: Takeda's voice remains level, efficient. He's building a picture of police work as both meticulous and broad. No surprise in his tone — this is just what the job includes. Slight settling on each task.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、捜査の参謀役を、警察、ベテランに任されますね
lines.en: In a case like this, the police entrust the strategic role to veterans — the ones with the experience to see the whole picture.
lines.style: Ren's voice carries admiration now, mixed with understanding. Slower pace. He's acknowledging the weight of that responsibility. Thoughtful pause before 「ベテラン」 — respect for experience.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、複数の事件が交錯する時の捜査も担当されますね
lines.en: And when multiple cases overlap, the police manage that complexity too — coordinating across investigations.
lines.style: Takeda nods into his words, voice close and almost confiding. He's describing the hidden work that holds everything together. Measured, grounded. A slight exhale after speaking, like he understands the weight of what he's describing.
